title: Readiness stage grid (FBS-206, TAC-4135)
description: Pure HTML string renderers (renderVerdictGrid, buildCell, reasonForCell) emitting the two-column stage grid (tree, delta) in the Overview sub-view: each VerdictGridCell carries pass, total, state and a failing-count link that targets the Blocking sub-tab filtered to the stage (AC-18005-1, -6). Acknowledged state and reason are read from stages[].state and the one reason helper so freezeRecord.gates is not read from the row renderer.
